tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: antique-cream
tokens.usage: Aged elegance, timeless foundation. Used as background on `body`.

tokens.name: pearl-cream
tokens.usage: Subtle luxury, refined finish. Used as background on `.data-table tbody tr:hover`, `.btn-secondary:hover`.

tokens.name: legacy-gold
tokens.usage: Endowment wealth, golden legacy. Used as text on `.nav-link:hover`, `.card-header-img`, `.card-category`. 2.3:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: heritage-burgundy
tokens.usage: Institutional tradition, donor trust. Used as text on `.badge-endowed`. 8.9:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: charcoal-gray
tokens.usage: Formal text, serious tone. Used as text on `body`, `.header-title`, `.card-title`. 13.1:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: silver-gray
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-subtitle`, `.footer-bottom`. 3.2:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: light-gray
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.footer`, `.footer-links a`. 1.4:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: category-tag-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: shadow/glow on `.crest-icon`; border on `.crest-icon`, `.footer-bottom`, `.category-tag`; background on `.category-tag`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.
